# mcloud queue

<!-- Generated by `go run ./internal/gendocs`: edit the source it names, not this file. -->

_Generated from the command's help in `internal/cli`._

[All commands](README.md)

Look at and retry an app's queued jobs.

The jobs of an app's queue functions live in its Postgres database (table
maxcloud\_jobs). These commands run psql in the database's primary pod, with
your kubeconfig.

| Command | |
| --- | --- |
| [`mcloud queue ls`](#mcloud-queue-ls) | Jobs per queue and state, and the latest jobs in one state |
| [`mcloud queue retry`](#mcloud-queue-retry) | Run failed jobs again |

## mcloud queue ls

Jobs per queue and state, and the latest jobs in one state.

```
mcloud queue ls [APP] [flags]
```

Examples:

```fish
mcloud queue ls shop                    # counts, and the latest failed jobs
mcloud queue ls shop --state pending --queue mail
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--db` string | `db` | the app's database (CloudNativePG cluster) holding the queue |
| `--limit` int | `20` | how many jobs to list |
| `--queue` string |  | only this queue |
| `--state` string | `failed` | jobs to list: pending, running, failed, done or all |

## mcloud queue retry

Run failed jobs again.

Puts failed jobs back in their queue with their attempts reset, so they
get the full number of tries again. Only failed jobs: pending and running
ones are left alone. Inside an app's repo, the app comes from maxcloud.yaml
and every argument is a job ID.

```
mcloud queue retry [APP] [ID...] [flags]
```

Examples:

```fish
mcloud queue retry shop 41 42
mcloud queue retry shop --failed --queue mail
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--db` string | `db` | the app's database (CloudNativePG cluster) holding the queue |
| `--failed` |  | retry every failed job (of --queue, if given) |
| `--queue` string |  | only this queue |
